businessPurpose: Decide how realistic fictional Universaarl customers should be prepared before any new Debitoren write gate.

decision.summary: Do not create the next customer yet. First run a read-first UI and template preflight on the Debitoren page/card. If the route proves templates, required fields, posting groups, VAT business group, payment terms and no-save boundary clearly enough, the first write gate may create exactly one realistic fictional customer manually in the UI. Configuration Packages or Excel-assisted import are the preferred later route for a small batch of multiple realistic customers after the field mapping and Foundation dependencies are clear.
whyThisRoute: Microsoft Learn supports both manual Customer Card creation and templates for new customers.
Microsoft Learn also supports configuration packages and Excel-assisted import for customer data.
PWS-MD-004C proves customer-card FastTabs for training, but not setup correctness.
The book and training need one fully explained manual example before a batch-loading route becomes meaningful.
A real customer project would not load several customers until mandatory fields and setup dependencies are understood.

routeComparison.fit: Best for the first training/customer-handbook example because users see the Debitorenkarte, required fields, templates and business meaning directly.
routeComparison.risk: Too slow and error-prone for many customers; must not be used before setup-sensitive fields are visible and understood.
routeComparison.nextAction: Run read-first UI/template preflight; no save.

routeComparison.fit: Good for consistent defaults such as posting group, VAT business group and payment terms if the template content is visible and source-backed.
routeComparison.risk: A template can hide wrong defaults. Do not trust it without visible values and reopen proof after a later write.
routeComparison.nextAction: Inspect template availability and visible/defaulted fields read-first.

routeComparison.fit: Best candidate for loading several realistic fictional customers once fields, dependencies and validation rules are known.
routeComparison.risk: Package import/validate/apply are effective setup/data actions and require a separate write gate plus rollback/cleanup plan.
routeComparison.nextAction: Park until one manual example and field mapping are proven.

routeComparison.fit: Useful for preparing customer data in a customer-project format and validating columns before import.
routeComparison.risk: Excel can make bad defaults look clean; no import until BC validation and package gate exist.
routeComparison.nextAction: Use as data preparation only until Configuration Package gate.

routeComparison.fit: Potential later integration path, not needed for the first customer learning/write gate.
routeComparison.risk: Bypasses the UI learning value and needs auth, integration ownership, idempotency and error handling.
routeComparison.nextAction: Do not use for first Universaarl customer setup.

routeComparison.fit: Only justified for reusable extension logic or missing standard capability.
routeComparison.risk: Overengineering for simple customer setup; requires build, publish, permissions and lifecycle governance.
routeComparison.nextAction: Do not use unless a real recurring product gap appears.

routeComparison.fit: Would be appropriate if Foundation gaps made even read-first customer route discovery misleading.
routeComparison.risk: Parking now would slow training and book progress despite enough evidence for a no-write preflight.
routeComparison.nextAction: Proceed with read-first preflight, not write.

allowed: Use realistic fictional Universaarl business partners.

notAllowed: No fake UI mockups as BC proof.
No CRONUS/RM-DEMO/Rhein-Main customers as active target truth.

foundationGapsBlockingWrite: Customer Posting Group correctness is not proven.
VAT Business Posting Group correctness is not proven.
General Business Posting Group/customer sales posting setup is not proven enough for O2C.
Payment Terms and Payment Method are not selected for the next real customer.
No O2C Preview Posting or ledger trace exists for Universaarl.
